blocks.content: The CAG is appointed by the President of India by warrant under his hand and seal. Before entering office, the CAG takes an oath to uphold the Constitution and perform duties without fear or favour.
The CAG is appointed by the President of India by warrant under his hand and seal.

items: The CAG is appointed by the President, NOT by a parliamentary committee or the Prime Minister.
The term 'warrant under his hand and seal' is a high constitutional standard frequently targeted in MCQs.
The oath specifies performing duties 'without fear or favour' before officially entering office.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) is appointed directly by the President of India.
The appointment requires a formal warrant under the President's hand and seal.
Before assuming office, the CAG must take an oath to perform duties without fear or favour and uphold the Constitution.
